activeCopywritingGuidelines: Always provide actionable domain advice and technical benchmarks before mentioning any tool or link.
Adopt the tone of an experienced peer or senior developer, never a marketer or promoter.
Structure comments in 3 concise paragraphs: Context/Analysis -> Technical Solution -> Neutral Resource Mention.
Use subtle, natural anchor framing with transparent attribution (e.g., 'benchmark setup', 'documented test').
